text: Phase 8 artifact ownership is now explicit: archive is format-neutral; archive-lna owns LNA schema/HDF5; latent is archive-independent; dataset imports neither archive nor latent; interop-archived-response owns LNA reconstruction, archive-aware latent codecs, dataset compatibility, representation bindings, and runtime. Recorded secondary edges are latent->image+locus-kernel for HRBF geometry and archive-lna->image for established LNA matrix wire values; neither violates the principal-domain boundaries.
